RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Crit ’n Cast
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants ability haste equal to 65% of your critical value. Critical value is not consumed.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Critical Missile
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A direct attack or ability critical hit fires a bonus missile for (7.8 + 1.95 × target health scale) damage per stack, at most once every 0.25 seconds. Missiles cannot generate more copies of themselves. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Critical Rhythm
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct attack critical hits grant rhythm stacks, up to 20, expiring after 10 seconds without another trigger. Each card stack adds 7.8% attack haste per rhythm stack. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Dashing
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants movement abilities 113.75% ability haste. Teaches Blink. Walking does not count; cooldowns remain at least 1 second. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Earthwake
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After a movement ability, its straight path erupts after 0.75 seconds, dealing 11.7 secondary damage per stack to up to 16 visible enemies within 2 cells of the path. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: En Passant
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Hit the marked flank within 3 cells to deal 6.5 × target health scale bonus damage per stack, heal 6.5 injury points and gain 22.75% movement speed for 3 seconds. Each target can trigger once per 4 seconds. Teaches Pursuit Mark; selecting the owner shows enemy flanks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Erosion
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct and ability hits accumulate 0.65 erosion per card stack. Whole stacks are applied to the struck target, capped at 10 for 10 seconds; fractional progress is retained by the attacker. Each stack grants 4 percentage points of armor penetration. Armor-ignoring damage gains no benefit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Ethereal Weapon
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: The first effective ability hit on each target per cast triggers owned burn, health-based damage, bounded chains and lifesteal at 65% of their usual strength. Does not repeat an entire attack. Teaches Pursuit Mark.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Executioner
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct attacks and abilities deal 32.5% extra damage per stack to enemies at 40% health or lower. Eligible kills refund 1.95 seconds of card-granted basic ability cooldown per stack. Does not instantly execute bosses. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Flashbang
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Enemies within 3.5 cells of your movement destination take 9.1 secondary damage per stack and are slowed for 5 seconds. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Infinite Recursion
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each eligible kill grants 0.65 permanent growth per card stack. Ability haste equals 10% of the square root of accumulated growth. Repeatedly resurrected enemies count only once.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mystic Punch
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Effective direct attacks refund 0.65 second of card-granted basic ability cooldown per stack, at most once every 0.25 seconds. Does not refund path ultimates or relic cooldowns. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Now You See Me
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Teaches Blink and Return. Within 3.25 seconds of moving, manually return to the previous origin within 12 visible cells on the same map. Returning does not create another origin.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Numb to Pain
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After armor and shields, defer 22.75% of ordinary injury per stack over the next 5 seconds, up to 75%. Deferred injury does not receive another defense or shield reduction; healing can buy time to survive. Draft limit: 3 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Outlaw’s Grit
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A successful movement ability grants a defensive stack for 8 seconds, up to 5. Each card stack adds 9.75% defense per defensive stack. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Quick Step
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Teaches Ringblade Rush: move, then strike in a circle. Each stack expands its radius by 0.4 cells, up to 2 extra cells. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Rejuvenation
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Successfully casting a combat ability heals 6 ordinary injury points per stack. Return, economic abilities and passive secondary damage do not trigger it. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shadow Runner
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After a movement ability, gain 48% movement speed per stack for 4 seconds. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Soul Siphon
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct attack and ability critical hits heal ordinary injuries for 13% of actual damage per stack. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Spin To Win
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants spinning abilities 19.5% damage and 19.5% ability haste; Thousand Blades gains 32.5% damage. Teaches Ringblade Rush. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Swift and Safe
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After a movement ability, gain a 20-point shield per stack for 4 seconds. Refreshes to the stronger shield value. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Thread the Needle
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct attacks and armor-checked abilities gain 13 percentage points of armor penetration per stack. Armor-ignoring secondary damage is unaffected. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Tooth Fairy
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Deal 25% of an eligible enemy core part's maximum health as actual damage within 2.5 seconds to drop a piercing fragment, once per target every 4 seconds. Collect within 2 cells for 0.65 permanent growth per card stack; fractions accumulate into whole stacks. Each whole stack adds 1 percentage point of penetration, capped at 200 points. Fragments last about 42 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Trailblazer
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After a movement ability, burn enemies within 3.5 cells of the destination. Each card stack adds 1.95 base damage per pulse. Does not ignite buildings. Teaches Blink. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Accelerating Sorcery
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Successful combat casts build sorcery, up to 20 stacks; it expires after 15 seconds without casting. Each sorcery stack grants 5.2% ability haste per card stack. Automatic missiles and echoes are not casts. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Archmage
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Successful combat casts refund 0.65 second per card stack from other recorded personal ability cooldowns. The cast itself receives no refund; an ability cannot recast in the same tick. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Echo Cast
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: The first effective ability hit on each enemy per cast echoes after 0.75 seconds, dealing secondary damage based on 29.25% of that actual hit per stack. Echoes do not repeat movement, healing, rewards or cast triggers. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Fan the Hammer
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Once per 1.5 seconds, a direct hit launches three missiles, each dealing 5.2 base secondary damage per stack. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Multishot
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Crystal Bolt combat hits build shared practice. At 20/40 practice, fire at one/two extra enemies within 7 cells of the target; extra bolts deal 65% of normal base damage. Practice grows at most once per second, benefits from growth bonuses and persists. Teaches Crystal Bolt.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Pursuit of Haste
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Crystal Bolt combat hits build shared practice. At 40/80 practice, each card stack grants 32.5%/65% bolt haste. Gain at most once per second, affected by growth bonuses. Cooldown remains at least 1 second. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Pursuit of Power
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Crystal Bolt combat hits build shared practice. At 40/80 practice, each card stack grants 48.75%/97.5% bolt damage. Gain at most once per second, affected by growth bonuses and retained in saves. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Spell Split
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A Crystal Bolt hit splits toward up to two other enemies within 6 cells. Each shard deals secondary damage based on 26% of the actual hit per stack. Shards cannot split again. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Triggered Inferno
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Alternate direct hits with successful combat casts. A six-step combo blasts enemies within 7 cells for 45.5 base secondary damage and 3.25 base burn damage per pulse per card stack. Repeated step types add nothing. The combo expires after 8 seconds, with a 10-second blast interval. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Twin Fire
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants 6.825% critical value. The first effective ability hit on each enemy per cast fires two missiles, each dealing 6.5 base secondary damage per stack. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Ultimate Awakening
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Casting a personal path ability refreshes basic abilities and grants them 65% ability haste per stack for 8 seconds. Awakening has a separate 15-second interval. Colony abilities do not trigger it. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Wild Fire
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: While drafted and able to act, automatically strike a visible enemy within 14 cells every 4 seconds, then jump to up to two different enemies within 5 cells of each other. Each hit deals 14.3 base secondary damage per stack. No target means no cooldown spent. Teaches Crystal Bolt. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Adamant
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Extending an enemy stun grants a defense stack, up to five, lasting 8 seconds. Each defense stack grants 13% defense per card stack. Control rewards are limited to once per second. Teaches Suppression Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: All For You
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack adds 34% to healing and shields applied to other colonists, not yourself. Adds to First-Aid Kit. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: First-Aid Kit
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack adds 20% to healing and shields you apply. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Holy Fire
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actual healing or new shielding on another colonist applies 1.95 base burn damage per pulse per card stack to up to eight enemies within 5 cells of them. Once per second. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mighty Shield
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Gaining new shield points grants 19.5% damage per stack for 6 seconds. Refreshing only the duration does not trigger it. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Porcupine
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actual injury from hostile direct attacks stores spines. At 40, strike up to eight enemies within 5 cells for 20 base secondary damage per stack and slow them. 10-second interval. Shield absorption grants no charge; downed pawns do not retaliate. Teaches Suppression Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Slap Around
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Extending an eligible enemy stun grants permanent offense, up to 200 stacks, affected by growth bonuses. Each offense stack grants 1.95% damage per card stack. Once per second. Teaches Suppression Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Sonic Boom
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actual healing or new shielding on another colonist strikes up to eight enemies within 5 cells of them for 7.8 base secondary damage per stack and slows them. Once per second. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Spirit Bomb
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actual healing and new shielding on other colonists store up to 200 energy. An effective support event reaching 150 spends 150 to heal up to eight colonists within 5 cells of the target for 20 base health and grant 24 base shield per stack. 10-second interval; the blast cannot charge itself. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Support Main
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After 300 actual healing to other colonists, subsequent heals grant five once-per-second heals, each restoring 3 base health per card stack. Progress persists. Renewal does not advance the quest or trigger support effects; only the strongest renewal applies. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Tormentor
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Extending an enemy stun applies 2.6 base burn damage per pulse per card stack. Once per second. Resisted stuns and attempts that do not extend the stun grant nothing. Teaches Suppression Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Windspeaker's Blessing
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actual healing or new shielding on another colonist grants 16.25% defense per card stack for 6 seconds. The strongest blessing applies. Teaches Aid Pulse. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Dawnbringer's Resolve
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health grants five once-per-second heals, each restoring 6.5 base health per stack. 30-second cooldown. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Divine Intervention
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Teaches Sanctuary Ring: protect yourself and visible colonists within 5 cells from direct damage for 1 second. Base cooldown: 30 seconds. Disease, missing organs and deferred injury debts still apply.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: DropBear
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Death leaves a crystal bear for 20 seconds. Each stack adds 32.5% to its damage inheritance multiplier. Once per colonist per day. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Escape Plan
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health grants 29.25 base shield and 39% movement speed per stack for 5 seconds. 30-second cooldown. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Hand of Baron
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants 13% personal damage and adds 19.5% to the summon damage inheritance multiplier. Teaches Drone Call. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Hellbent
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Forty eligible direct hits charge one rescue, counting at most once per 0.5 seconds. A lethal injury spends the charge to heal recoverable injuries; a successful rescue protects from direct damage for 1.3 seconds. 150-second cooldown. Missing organs, disease and execution are not prevented.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Hive Mind
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every 200 actual direct damage summons a crystal drone, at most once per 5 seconds. Each stack adds 9.75% summon damage. Teaches Drone Call. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Minionmancer
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack adds 32.5% to summon health and damage inheritance multipliers. Teaches Drone Call. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mirror Image
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health summons two combat echoes, once per 30 seconds. Each stack adds 16.25% to echo damage inheritance. Echoes grant no invisibility and copy no equipment or work skills. Teaches Echo Projection. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Serve Beyond Death
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health grants 8 seconds of borrowed life: 32.5% damage and 26 base healing per stack, plus 2 seconds of direct-damage protection. Personally killing an eligible enemy settles the debt; otherwise suffer a 10-second stun. 60-second cooldown. Does not resurrect the dead. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Trickster Demon
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A destroyed echo strikes up to eight enemies within 4 cells for 22.75 base secondary damage per stack. Natural expiry causes no blast. Teaches Echo Projection. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Vengeance
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A player humanlike colonist downed or killed within 18 cells grants 39% damage per stack for 10 seconds, at most once per 10 seconds. Summons do not trigger it. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Aftershock Echo
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Within 6 seconds of a movement ability, the first spin hit releases a 3-cell shockwave: up to 4 enemies take 8 base secondary damage per stack. 4-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Alternating Rhythm
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Alternating basic and ability hits deal 12% of actual hit damage as extra base damage, capped at 20. Consecutive hits of the same type gain nothing. 0.5-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bloodstep
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Within 6 seconds after a movement ability, your next damaging basic hit heals 6 ordinary injury points per stack. Once per movement.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Cinder Return
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Accumulate 20 actual burn damage to store one return, capped at one. Your next basic hit heals 5 ordinary injury points per stack.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Close Quarters
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Basic hits within 3 cells deal 18% of actual damage as extra base damage, capped at 30. Basic attacks against more distant enemies deal 12% less damage before mitigation.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Ember Relay
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: When your summon hits a burning enemy, apply a burn for 2 base damage per stack each second, six times. 2-second cooldown per owner. Does not trigger owner basic-hit rewards.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Frost Circuit
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Basic hits against slowed or stunned enemies arc to up to 2 other enemies within 6 cells for 6 base secondary damage per stack. 3-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shared Spring
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Accumulate 15 actual healing on other colonists to give yourself and the latest recipient 10 base shield per stack for 5 seconds. 4-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Lone Blade
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: On a basic hit with no other player colonist within 6 cells, deal 18% of the actual hit as extra base damage, capped at 30.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Field Medic
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After actually healing another colonist for at least 1 point, your next basic hit within 6 seconds deals 20% of actual damage as extra base damage, capped at 30. Stores one charge.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mercy Arc
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Accumulate 20 actual healing on yourself or an ally to store one arc, capped at one. Your next basic hit chains to up to 2 other enemies within 8 cells of the target, dealing 8 base secondary damage per stack.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Patient Hunter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After 5 seconds without a damaging basic hit, your next basic hit deals 30% of its actual damage as extra base damage, capped at 35. Secondary damage does not restart the timer.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shattered Fury
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After an enemy breaks your shield, your next basic hit within 3 cells in the following 6 seconds deals 12 base secondary damage per stack. Natural shield expiry does not trigger this.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Soul Lantern
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Personally killing an eligible or trial enemy with a basic attack grants 12 base shield per stack for 6 seconds. 3-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Distant Spark
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Hitting an enemy at least 12 cells away with an ability primes your next basic hit within 6 seconds for 10 base secondary damage per stack. 3-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Roaming Hunter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Switching basic attacks to a different enemy deals 15% of actual hit damage as extra base damage, capped at 25. The first target grants no bonus. 1-second cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Tempered Reprisal
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Accumulate 20 shield damage absorbed from enemies to store one reprisal, capped at one. The first hit of your next ability deals 10 base secondary damage per stack.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Twin Convergence
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Cast two different combat abilities within 6 seconds to prime your next basic hit. Strike up to 3 other enemies within 3 cells of the target for 7 base secondary damage per stack. Stores one charge.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Storm Flywheel
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Storm Spin and Wind-down Strike. Starting a spin grants 24 shield, at most once every 8 seconds regardless of haste or cooldown refunds. Every 0.5 seconds, hit up to 8 enemies for 3.5 base ability damage. The first 3 seconds cost no shield; each later pulse spends 8 shield, for at most 12 seconds total. Reserve 0/10/25/50 shield with the pawn command (default 10). Movement remains available; standing still grows the radius from 3 to 4.5 cells. Wind-down ends the spin and strikes one enemy for 8 plus 1.5 per completed pulse, capped at 44 base damage. Existing spin abilities also start the flywheel, but cannot stack or refresh an active spin.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Prismatic Magazine
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Stores 5 prismatic rounds. A damaging basic ranged hit on an enemy spends one round for 6 extra base damage; the last round deals 10. At most one round is spent per 0.25 seconds; pellets and secondary procs cannot spend extra rounds. Lethal hits still spend a round. After 3 seconds without spending ammunition, restore one round, then one every 2 seconds. Walking 6 sampled cells restores one round, at most once per 2 seconds; movement abilities do not count. Grants Empty the Magazine: spend every remaining round for 7 base ability damage each. Requires an equipped ranged weapon. Autocast waits for a full magazine.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Resonance Node
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Deploy Node, Resonance Pulse and Recall Node. Place a stationary projection lasting 30 seconds within 12 cells, or designate one of your own summons as a relay. A relay must remain within 18 cells of its owner with clear line of sight. Resonance Pulse, Crystal bolt and Aid pulse cast from the linked summon; range and sight are measured from it. Other abilities are unchanged. A broken link falls back to the caster. Resonance Pulse deals 14 base damage. Recall consumes the designated summon, grants 16 shield and strengthens the next Resonance Pulse within 6 seconds to 21 base damage. Recall is manual only and can be used once every 6 seconds, regardless of haste or cooldown refunds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Twin Resonance
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Resonance Node. Keep two nodes. Deploy fills an empty slot, then replaces the second node when both are occupied. Resonance Pulse, Crystal bolt and Aid pulse use the nearer node that can reach and see their target. Each cast still happens once. If neither node can cover the target, cast from the owner. Resonance Pulse deals 11 damage, or 16 after recall. Recall consumes only one node and grants 12 shield. Each node still needs clear sight to its owner within 18 cells. One active branch per core; switch in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Escort Array
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Resonance Node. Deployed projections follow a chosen friendly humanlike colonist using normal paths; they follow the owner by default. Use Choose escort target to change the ally. A relay must stay within 8 cells of its owner and 4 of the escorted ally, with clear sight along both links, giving up distant fixed coverage. Casting Resonance Pulse or Aid pulse through the node grants the ally 6 shield for 6 seconds, once per 6 seconds. Only card projections can be used, not ordinary summons. If the ally leaves the map, falls down or dies, the node follows its owner. One active branch per core; switch in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Sheltering Vortex
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Storm Flywheel. Each pulse can transfer up to 2 of your shield to each of up to 3 friendly humanlike colonists within 4 cells and clear sight, topping them up to 12 shield for 3 seconds. Allies with stronger shields spend none of your shield. Transfers respect your shield reserve and require enough shield for every recipient. Spin damage falls from 3.5 to 1.5; wind-down damage is halved. Protecting allies spends the same shield that keeps the flywheel running. One active branch per core; switch in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Overloaded Flywheel
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Storm Flywheel. Spin damage falls from 3.5 to 2.2 per pulse. Wind-down becomes a 60-degree cone aimed at the chosen enemy, reaching 10 cells and hitting up to 8 enemies. Walls block damage. Each completed pulse adds 3 base damage to the finisher, for 8–80 damage. Trade sustained damage for a well-aimed burst. One active branch per core; switch in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Piercing Chamber
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Magazine. Empty the Magazine fires along a straight line toward the chosen enemy, reaching 28 cells and 1.2 cells to either side. Hit up to 6 enemies; walls stop the shot. Each round deals 5 base damage per enemy instead of 7. Basic shots are unchanged. Line up enemies to make the lower damage per target worthwhile. One active branch per core; switch in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Quickdraw Magazine
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Magazine. Capacity falls from 5 rounds to 3. Regular bonus hits deal 4 instead of 6 base damage; the last round still deals 10. Walking 3 cells reloads one round, at most once per second. Passive reload slows to one round every 3 seconds; the initial delay after spending rounds remains 3 seconds. Reach last-round hits more often, but store less burst and reload more slowly while stationary. Movement abilities do not charge walking reloads. One active branch per core; switch in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bodyguard Barrier
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After taking actual damage from an enemy basic hit, gain 10 shield for 4 seconds if one of your ordinary projections is within 4 cells and clear sight. At most once every 6 seconds. The shield protects against later hits; resonance nodes do not count.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Molten Brand
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Molten Brand and Detonate. Mark an enemy within 24 cells for 8 seconds, on a 4-second cooldown. Keep up to 3 marks; only one per target. Store 20% of actual damage dealt by the owner, up to 36. On expiry or death, deal 8 base damage plus stored damage to up to 8 enemies within 3 cells; walls block the blast. Stored damage cannot gain attacker amplification or critical hits again. Detonate consumes the selected mark. Autocast waits for 24 stored damage or 2 seconds remaining. Brand blasts and this set's bonus hits cannot charge marks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bursting Cinders
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Molten Brand. Enemies actually damaged by a brand blast and still standing receive cinders: 2 base burn damage per second for 3 seconds. Cinders cannot charge marks or spread.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Lingering Embers
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: When an enemy dies with your stacking burn, share 30% of its remaining base burn damage between up to 2 enemies within 4 cells, capped at 40 each, over 3 seconds. Transferred embers cannot spread again; newly applied burns can. Walls block spread.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Quick Fuse
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Molten Brand. Early manual or automatic detonation refunds half the remaining Molten Brand cooldown, at most 3 seconds. Expiry and death give no refund. Each early detonation refunds once; unaccumulated damage is lost.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Coordinated Hunt
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: When you and one of your ordinary projections land basic hits on the same enemy within 3 seconds, deal 6 extra base damage, at most once every 2 seconds. Either side may strike first; repeated hits from the same side do not trigger it. Resonance nodes do not count.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Legion Command
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Call the Swarm, Rally Legion and Focus Legion. Call the Swarm uses the existing two temporary projections and summon limits. One order directs all of your ordinary projections, including later summons. Rally defends a point within 24 cells and attacks enemies within 6 cells of it. Focus pursues the chosen enemy using normal paths. If that target becomes invalid or moves over 30 cells from the owner, return to guarding the owner. Rally at your own feet to resume guard duty. Resonance nodes, other owners' projections and animals are unaffected.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Rising Heat
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After 3 damaging basic hits on the same enemy, apply 2 base stacking burn damage per second for 6 seconds, at most once every 3 seconds. Changing targets or waiting 5 seconds resets the count. Count at most one hit per 0.25 seconds; chains and pellets add no extra counts. Works without Molten Brand.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Encirclement
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: When one of your ordinary projections lands a basic hit, deal 4 extra base damage if at least two of your ordinary projections are within 3 cells of that enemy with clear sight. At most once per owner every 2 seconds. Projections must physically surround the target; resonance nodes do not count.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Frontline Exchange
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Frontline Exchange: swap with one of your ordinary projections within 18 cells and clear sight, on a 12-second cooldown. Both cells must be walkable. Gain 12 shield for 3 seconds; the projection takes 25% less damage for 3 seconds. Cannot swap with resonance nodes. Manual only, learned from this card; requires an ordinary projection.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Banner Echo
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Legion Command. Within 4 seconds after a Rally or Focus order, the first damaging hit by your ordinary projection grants you 6 shield for 3 seconds, at most every 8 seconds. Returning to guard does not trigger it; repeated orders cannot reset the cooldown.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Rift Scatter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After actually moving with an existing movement ability, your next basic hit within 3 seconds releases a 60-degree cone toward the target, reaching 6 cells and dealing 4 base damage to up to 3 enemies. Walls block it; at most once every 6 seconds. Grants no movement ability. Frontline Exchange also primes it; ordinary walking does not.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Close Cover
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: When your ranged basic hit damages an enemy within 6 cells, grant one other friendly humanlike colonist within 4 cells and clear sight 6 shield for 3 seconds, at most every 6 seconds. Cannot shield yourself; no eligible nearby ally means no trigger.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Collapsing Core
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Molten Brand. Keep only 1 brand. Store 25% of owner damage instead of 20%, up to 48 instead of 36. Deal 12 base damage plus stored damage, but reduce radius to 1.5 cells and hit at most 3 enemies. One active branch per core. Switch outside combat with no active brands.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Fire Adjustment
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After casting an enemy-targeted ability, a basic hit on a different enemy within 3 seconds deals 6 extra base damage, at most every 4 seconds. Molten Brand, Detonate and Focus Legion do not qualify. Repeated hits on the same target cannot consume this setup; keep only one setup.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Linked Fuses
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Molten Brand. Early detonation chains through your brands within 6 cells and clear sight, up to 3. Each deals 6 base damage plus 70% of stored damage. Expiry and death do not start chains. Consume the whole chain before damage; Quick Fuse refunds only once per command. One active branch per core.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Relay Reload
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Magazine. Your damaging ranged basic hit tags one target for 3 seconds. Your ordinary projection hitting it consumes the tag and restores 1 prismatic round, at most every 6 seconds. A full magazine preserves the tag. Keep one target per owner; resonance nodes do not count.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Rotating Front
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Legion Command. Ordinary projection damage falls by 15%. After a projection damages an enemy, Rally at the owner's feet to withdraw. Rest within 4 cells and clear sight of the owner for 2 seconds. Issue Rally or Focus to attack again: a rested projection's first hit deals 6 extra base damage, at most once per owner every 8 seconds. Guard mode holds position and waits for orders.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Breach Follow-up
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Molten Brand. If early detonation damages the selected branded target, leave a breach for 3 seconds. Your next basic hit on that target deals 6 extra base damage and consumes it. Keep one breach per owner; other targets in a chain do not gain one.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shield-fed Magazine
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Magazine. Gain a manual reload command: spend 12 existing shield to restore 1 prismatic round, with a 6-second cooldown. A full magazine, insufficient shield or inability to act spends nothing. Does not reset passive reload or skill cooldowns. Voluntary spending is not hostile damage or shield break.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Tempered Afterheat
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Molten Brand. On natural expiry, gain shield equal to 20% of stored damage, up to 8, for 4 seconds, at most every 6 seconds. Death and early detonation do not trigger this. Shield does not stack or gain healing amplification; a stronger existing shield is retained.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Lone Warden
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Legion Command. New ordinary projections become wardens: double their health multiplier and raise their damage multiplier by 50%, using 2 summon slots. Keep only 1 ordinary projection; further summons neither heal nor extend it. Resonance nodes are unchanged. Switch legion branches outside combat with no ordinary projections present.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bulwark Stance
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Momentary Guard. Riposte hits the selected target first and up to two other enemies within 2 cells of the caster, for 6 base ability damage each. Damaged survivors move 25% slower for 2 seconds. Walls block it. Keeps the 2-second guard window; mutually exclusive with Duelist Riposte.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Covering Guard
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Momentary Guard. A successful guard grants 4 base shield for 3 seconds to the nearest eligible humanlike colonist within 4 cells and clear sight. Excludes the caster; does nothing without an eligible ally.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Duelist Riposte
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Momentary Guard. Shortens the guard window from 2 seconds to 1, but Riposte deals 16 base ability damage to its selected target. One block, a 4-second riposte opportunity and fixed 12-second recovery remain. Choose this or Bulwark Stance in the build panel.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Smoldering Mechanism
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Mines. A mine that deals actual damage burns surviving targets for 1 base damage each second, four times. Uses existing burn refresh rules, without separate stacking burn entries or additional detonations.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shrapnel Field
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Mines. New mines trigger within 1 cell instead of 1.5. Their blast still reaches 2 cells and up to four enemies, now for 14 extra base damage each. Warning, deployment recovery and limits are unchanged. Mutually exclusive with Tripwire Field.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Prismatic Mines
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Deploy Mine, Detonate Mine and Disarm Mine. Place a temporary device in an empty cell within 12 cells. Arms after 1 second and lasts 30 seconds. Up to 3 per owner and 12 per map; deploy once per 6 seconds regardless of haste or refunds. An enemy within 1.5 cells and clear sight starts a half-second warning, then the blast deals 10 extra base damage to up to 4 enemies within 2 cells. Walls block it. Manually detonate armed mines or disarm untriggered ones; disarming returns no items and resets no cooldown. Removed when the owner dies or leaves the map. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Exploit the Opening
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Momentary Guard. A riposte that damages its selected enemy marks an opening for 3 seconds. Your next basic hit on that enemy consumes it for 4 extra base damage. Holds one target only; secondary damage cannot consume or repeat it.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Momentary Guard
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants Guard Stance and Riposte. Guard for 2 seconds against one enemy direct hit, blocking up to 12 damage. Existing Hex shields are spent first; remaining damage passes through guard, then armor. A successful block stores one riposte for 4 seconds: deal 10 base ability damage to an enemy within 2 cells. Guard may start once per 12 seconds regardless of haste or cooldown refunds. Damage over time, self or friendly damage, explosions and this mod's secondary damage cannot trigger it. Manual only. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Guarded Recovery
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Momentary Guard. A riposte that deals actual damage grants 4 base shield for 3 seconds. An area riposte grants this once, regardless of targets hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Reposition the Field
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Mines and a learned Spin, Blink, Hunt or Swap movement ability. Actually moving with one of these skills extends your next deployment to 16 cells for 3 seconds, at most once every 8 seconds. Consumed by one deployment; does not reset deployment recovery or grant movement skills.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Recovered Ammunition
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Mines and Prismatic Magazine. A detonation dealing actual damage restores one round to a non-full magazine, at most once per owner every 6 seconds. Multiple targets and paired tripwires still grant one round. Does not reset normal reload timing.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Tripwire Field
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Requires Prismatic Mines. The oldest two armed mines form a tripwire when within 6 cells with clear sight; a third waits in reserve. An enemy within 0.7 cells of the segment starts a half-second warning. Both ends are consumed, dealing 5 extra base damage to up to four enemies still on the wire and slowing damaged survivors by 25% for 3 seconds. Moving away avoids it. Unpaired mines only detonate manually, within 2 cells for the same damage and slow. Mutually exclusive with Shrapnel Field.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Covering Fire
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Taking actual damage from an enemy's basic attack while remaining standing marks the attacker. A teammate's basic hit on that enemy grants you 6 shield for 6 seconds. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Crossfire
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A damaging basic hit leaves an opening. A teammate's basic hit on that enemy deals 4 extra fixed base damage. 6-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Flanking Strike
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A damaging basic hit leaves an opening. A teammate's basic hit deals 6 extra fixed base damage if the two colonists form an angle of at least 90 degrees around the enemy. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Rolling Pressure
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Damaging an enemy with an ability leaves an opening. A teammate's basic hit reduces your longest eligible learned personal combat cooldown by 1 second, without making it immediately ready. Preserves the opening if none is cooling down. Shared abilities, utility skills and fixed recovery timers are unaffected. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Field Relief
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actually healing at least 2 injury points on a teammate with this mod's healing effects prepares a relay. That teammate's damaging basic hit on an enemy grants both of you 4 shield for 4 seconds. Self-healing and overhealing do not count. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shared Burden
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A damaging basic hit leaves an opening. If that enemy's basic attack actually damages another standing teammate, the teammate gains 6 shield and you gain 3 shield, both for 6 seconds. Shields appear after the hit and cannot absorb its damage. 8-second recovery after triggering. The opening lasts 4 seconds; one target per card. Requires a different standing player humanlike colonist within 12 cells and clear sight of the owner. The teammate needs no matching card; summons do not count. Secondary damage cannot complete a relay. Each relay type resolves at most once per hit.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Antitoxin charter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants all colonists 45.5 percentage points of toxic resistance and 50% immunity gain speed. Native resistance caps still apply.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Spoils of war
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants 19.5 additional silver when any colonist kills a standing enemy. Bounties are combined and delivered about every 4.2 seconds, or saved until a receiving map is available. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Sunfire host
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants all colonists 0.65 Sunfire level per stack. About every 4.2 seconds, deals 18 × level armor-piercing damage to up to 16 standing enemies within 5.5 cells. The aura pauses while downed. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Glitterworld medical crate
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Provides 1 glitterworld medicine each day and adds 60% immunity gain speed to all colonists per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Colony haste
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 12% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Ascendant haulers
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 100% carrying capacity and 12% movement speed per stack. Ordinary hauling rules, including single-stack limits, still apply. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Field hospital
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 75% medical tend speed and 30% tend quality per stack. Medicine and the game's quality caps still apply. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Gifted minds
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 50% global learning speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Colony overclock
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 30% damage against enemies, 30% health and 30% global work speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Medical reserve
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Provides 3 medicine each day and adds 60% immunity gain speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Astral healers
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants all colonists 0.65 group-healing level per stack. Valid hits trigger at most once per second, healing up to 12 friendly colonists within 8 cells, including the attacker, for 8 × level ordinary injury points each. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Silver tongues
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 75% social impact and 35% learning speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shared ascension
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 45.5% health per stack. A full contribution share grants each eligible participant 0.65 permanent soul mark per stack. Each mark adds 4% damage against enemies and heals 0.02 ordinary injury points per second. Draft limit: 8 stacks. Fractional growth carries over into whole marks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns. Share growth among holders of the same ability who contributed in the last 30 seconds, using each holder's own rate. Count damage, added stun time and Hex-attributed healing or shield absorption. Healing must repair recent enemy damage. If damage contributors are present, support takes at most 25% of the pool. Bystanders, ordinary animals, prisoners and finishing downed targets give no growth.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Colony of thorns
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants all colonists 0.65 thorns level per stack. After taking direct damage from an enemy, retaliates for 18 × level + 50% of actual damage taken as armor-piercing damage. At most once per second per colonist. Environmental and additional damage do not trigger it. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Resonant storm
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 0.65 chain level and 15.925% damage against enemies per stack. Every 3 valid direct hits against standing enemies, each colonist releases lightning from the struck target to other standing enemies. Default radius: 16 cells; adjustable from 8–32. Hits up to 2 + rounded-up total chain level targets, capped at 12. Ordinary neutral animals do not trigger it. Draft limit: 8 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Blood pact
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 10% direct-damage lifesteal and heal 0.3 points of ordinary injuries per second per stack. Healing does not restore missing body parts. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Wildfire protocol
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants all colonists 1.3 burn levels per stack. Valid hits apply four burn pulses, each dealing 6 × level armor-piercing damage at one-second intervals. Further hits refresh the pulse count. Burns from multiple attackers keep the stronger effect. Does not start fires. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Thousand-blade echo
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 0.65 to melee and ranged cooldown divisors. Every third valid hit delivers two additional strikes to the original target, each dealing 39% of this hit's direct damage. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Crimson whirlwind
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every second valid hit deals 29.25 + 26% of this hit's direct damage as spinning-blade damage to up to 16 other standing enemies within 5 cells of the target. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: All flesh as one
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 65% health and 19.5% direct lifesteal. A full contribution share grants 1.3 additional permanent feast stacks. The killing blow still heals 16.25 injury points. Each feast stack adds 4% health and 3% damage. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns. Share growth among holders of the same ability who contributed in the last 30 seconds, using each holder's own rate. Count damage, added stun time and Hex-attributed healing or shield absorption. Healing must repair recent enemy damage. If damage contributors are present, support takes at most 25% of the pool. Bystanders, ordinary animals, prisoners and finishing downed targets give no growth.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Crimson chalice
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 32.5% direct lifesteal. Converts 65% of the wearer's excess healing into a shield on the recipient for 10 seconds. Accumulated shield capacity is capped at 400 × health bonus multiplier.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Molten judgment
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants 0.65 burn level. Every fourth valid hit consumes the wearer's ordinary and stacking burns on the target, immediately dealing 130% of their remaining damage.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Undying embers
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants 0.65 burn level. Once per second, the wearer's burn can spread a level-0.65 burn lasting 4 seconds to the nearest 2 other enemies within 5 cells of its target.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Frostshatter throne
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants 0.65 Everfrost level. Successfully stunning an enemy deals 39 frost damage to up to 16 standing enemies within 4 cells of it. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Walking winter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: About every 4.2 seconds, slows the nearest 12 enemies within 8 cells by 30% for 5 seconds. Every 12.5 seconds, deals 39 frost damage to those enemies.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Heaven's bulwark
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 0.65 to the damage-taken divisor. After a shield absorbs an enemy's direct attack, returns 130% of the absorbed amount to the attacker. Cooldown: 1 second. Retaliations cannot trigger each other recursively.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Astral sanctuary
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: About every 8.3 seconds, grants a 65-point shield to the nearest 12 friendly humanlike colonists within 10 cells. Lasts 10 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Torrent of life
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All player humanlike colonists gain 65% health, 1.95 injury points of healing per second and 130% plant harvest yield. The yield bonus applies to the actual harvest.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Distant execution
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct attacks against enemies at least 12 cells away deal 65% more damage. Secondary damage does not receive this multiplier again.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Star-piercing shot
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After a valid hit, extends a straight path 12 cells behind the target, about 2.5 cells wide. Standing enemies in the path take 48.75% of this hit's direct damage. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Chorus of souls
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every third valid hit fires a soul bolt at each of the nearest 3 standing enemies within 8 cells of the impact. Each bolt deals 19.5 + 1.3 × permanent soul marks damage. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Soul vault
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: A full contribution share grants 1.95 additional permanent soul marks. The killing blow still heals 19.5 injury points. Each soul mark adds 4% damage and 0.02 regeneration per second. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns. Share growth among holders of the same ability who contributed in the last 30 seconds, using each holder's own rate. Count damage, added stun time and Hex-attributed healing or shield absorption. Healing must repair recent enemy damage. If damage contributors are present, support takes at most 25% of the pool. Bystanders, ordinary animals, prisoners and finishing downed targets give no growth.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Storm network
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Grants 0.65 chain level. Chain hits leave the attacker's storm mark for 8 seconds. A marked enemy's death releases lightning at the nearest 3 enemies within 12 cells, dealing 32.5 + 6.5 × chain level damage. These secondary kills cannot trigger further discharges.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Heaven's charge
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every third valid hit strikes the original target for an additional 65 + 65% of this hit's direct damage as lightning damage. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Deathless mountain
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 65% health. After standing still for about 5 seconds, gains a shield of 65 × actual health scale every 5 seconds, lasting about 8 seconds. Moving resets the waiting period.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mountain's wrath
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 65% health. Every third valid hit deals 13 × the wearer's actual health scale as shock damage to up to 16 standing enemies within 6 cells of the impact.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: War bonds
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Whenever a player humanlike colonist kills a standing enemy, the colony gains 65 additional silver. Secondary kills cannot recursively trigger this evolution's reward.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Desperate fury
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each 10% of overall health lost adds 42% direct damage against enemies per stack, up to 273% per stack. Also adds 0.2275 to the damage-taken divisor per stack. Missing body parts affect overall health. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Art of destruction
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 1.3 detonation levels per stack. Every 4 valid hits causes an enemy-only blast within 4.5 cells of the target. Stacks with Detonation orb. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bounty hunter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 15% damage against enemies per stack. Each standing enemy killed grants another 40 silver per stack. Combines with Spoils of war and Gambler's coin; rewards are delivered in batches. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Thunderlord
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 1.3 chain levels and 30% damage against enemies per stack, combining with Runecarver and Resonant storm. Every 3 valid direct hits against standing enemies releases lightning to others around the target. Default radius: 16 cells; adjustable from 8–32. Hits up to 2 + rounded-up total chain level other enemies, capped at 12. Ordinary neutral animals do not trigger it. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Splintering strikes
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 1.3 cleave levels per stack. Every 2 valid hits, up to 8 other standing enemies within 3.5 cells of the target take 14 × level + 30% of this hit's direct damage as additional armor-piercing damage. Works with melee and ranged attacks. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Battlefield surgeon
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 100% tend speed, 40% tend quality and 0.65 group-healing level per stack. Valid hits trigger healing at most once per second, restoring 8 × group-healing level injury points to up to 12 friendly colonists within 8 cells. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Close-quarters dominion
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 68.25% direct damage against enemies within 3 cells per stack. Melee cooldown is divided by (1 + 0.455 × stacks). Close-range gunfire also receives the damage bonus. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Terminator
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack adds 25% direct damage and 7.5 percentage points to the execution threshold, capped at 65%. Hits below the threshold deal massive secondary damage.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Endless feast
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 25% health per stack. A full contribution share grants 0.65 permanent feast stack per card stack. The killing blow still heals 7.8 injury points per card stack. Each feast stack adds 4% health and 3% damage against enemies. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Fractional growth carries over into whole marks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns. Share growth among holders of the same ability who contributed in the last 30 seconds, using each holder's own rate. Count damage, added stun time and Hex-attributed healing or shield absorption. Healing must repair recent enemy damage. If damage contributors are present, support takes at most 25% of the pool. Bystanders, ordinary animals, prisoners and finishing downed targets give no growth.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Master arsonist
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 22.75% damage against enemies and 1.95 burn levels per stack. Hits apply four pulses of 6 × burn level armor-piercing damage, one per second. Repeated hits refresh the count without delaying the next pulse. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Glacial augmentation
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 1.3 Everfrost levels per stack. Every 3 valid hits stuns the target for (45 + 15 × level) ticks, capped at 180 ticks. Everfrost has a 3-second cooldown per attacker. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Damage gate
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 91% health and 0.455 astral level per stack. After mitigation, a single hit deals at most 15 ÷ astral level health damage, with a minimum cap of 1 point. Repeated damage instances are resolved separately. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Master of arms
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 20% damage against enemies per stack. Aiming time and melee cooldown are divided by (1 + 0.455 × stacks), regardless of weapon changes. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Baptism of light
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 1.3 group-healing levels and 0.6 regeneration per second per stack. Valid hits trigger at most once per second, healing up to 12 friendly colonists within 8 cells for 8 × group-healing level injury points each. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Fervor of battle
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Valid hits build a combo, lost after 10 seconds without a hit. Each combo hit adds 0.065 per stack to melee and ranged cooldown divisors; each stack also adds 0.2275 to the base divisors. Draft limit: 6 stacks. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Exceptional intellect
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 150% research speed and 120% global learning speed per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Deadeye
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Beyond 4 cells, each additional cell adds 4.55% direct damage against enemies per stack, counting at most 25 extra cells. Aiming time is divided by (1 + 0.455 × stacks). The damage bonus uses both pawns' positions at impact. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Soul furnace
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 45.5% damage against enemies per stack. A full contribution share grants 1.3 permanent soul marks per stack. Each mark adds 4% damage against enemies and 0.02 regeneration per second. Soul marks are saved with the colonist. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Fractional growth carries over into whole marks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns. Share growth among holders of the same ability who contributed in the last 30 seconds, using each holder's own rate. Count damage, added stun time and Hex-attributed healing or shield absorption. Healing must repair recent enemy damage. If damage contributors are present, support takes at most 25% of the pool. Bystanders, ordinary animals, prisoners and finishing downed targets give no growth.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Heartsteel
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 25% health per stack. Hitting a standing enemy grants 0.65 permanent steel mark per stack, once every 2 seconds. Each mark adds another 3% health. Draft limit: 6 stacks. Fractional growth carries over into whole marks. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Solar incarnation
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 45.5% health and 1.95 Sunfire levels per stack. While standing, scorches up to 16 standing enemies within 5.5 cells about every 4.2 seconds, dealing 18 × Sunfire level armor-piercing damage each. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Armored dragon turtle
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 45.5% health and 1.3 thorns levels per stack. After taking direct enemy damage, retaliates for 18 × thorns level + 50% of actual damage taken as armor-piercing damage, at most once per second. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Colossus
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 120% health, 20% movement speed and 0.6 to the damage-taken divisor per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Trigger overload
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 25% damage against enemies per stack. Ranged cooldown is divided by (1 + 0.7 × stacks); aiming time and burst intervals are unchanged. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bloodforged covenant
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Actual healing refreshes a shield on the recipient equal to 97.5% of healing dealt, lasting 10 seconds. After absorbing 200 shield damage, heals up to 12 free colonists within 10 cells for 39 ordinary injury points each. Cooldown: 1 second. This healing does not retrigger these healing interactions.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Frozen kill zone
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct hits against frost-slowed or stunned enemies release a 4-cell frost blast at the target, dealing 117 + 48.75% of this hit's direct damage to up to 6 enemies. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Soulblade dance
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every third valid direct hit releases soulblades at up to 3 enemies within 8 cells of the target. Each deals 52 + 1.3 × soul marks + 19.5% of this hit's direct damage. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Thunderfire calamity
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Chain hits create at most one thunderfire field per second, with a 3.5-cell radius and a 4-second duration. Each second it deals 29.25 + 6.5 × chain level additional damage and applies burns to up to 16 enemies. Enemies dying with the wearer's burn release a 6-cell thunderburst, hitting up to 12 enemies for 65 + 13 × burn level damage. Thunderburst cooldown: 1 second.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Convergence of blades
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 1.3 to melee and ranged cooldown divisors. Every fourth valid direct hit delivers up to five extra cuts to the original target, each dealing 52 + 26% of this hit's direct damage. Stops if the target can no longer fight. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Undying blood emperor
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 65% direct lifesteal. Every 200 points of actual healing releases a blood tide if enemies are within 8 cells. Deals 130 + 16.25 × the wearer's health multiplier damage to up to 12 enemies and heals up to 12 free colonists within 10 cells for 65 ordinary injury points each. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: World-burning sun
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 2.6 burn levels. Every fifth valid direct hit leaves a 6-cell Sunfire field at the target for 6 seconds. Each second it deals 52 + 13 × burn level additional damage and applies burns to up to 16 enemies. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Everwinter throne
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: During combat, every 6 seconds freezes up to 16 enemies within 12 cells, applying frost slow and a 2-second stun. Targets already slowed or stunned take an additional 117 damage.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Shelter of armies
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 0.65 to the damage-taken divisor. While an enemy is within 30 cells, every 6 seconds refreshes a 195-point shield on up to 12 free colonists within 12 cells, lasting 8 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Ark of life
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 195% plant harvest yield and 130% health. Each day provides 52 packaged survival meals and 13 medicine, and heals every free colonist for 104 ordinary injury points.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Star-piercing arbalest
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every third valid direct hit against a target at least 12 cells away fires a piercing beam. It crosses the target and extends 18 cells behind it, about 4 cells wide, dealing 130 + 130% of this hit's direct damage to enemies struck. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Crown of the dead
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 2.6 soul-harvesting levels and 3.9 additional soul marks per kill. Every fifth valid direct hit releases a soul tide at up to 8 enemies within 12 cells of the target, dealing 19.5 + 3.25 × soul marks additional damage each. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Lord of thunder
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 2.6 chain levels. Every fourth valid direct hit calls lightning onto up to 10 enemies within 18 cells of the target, dealing 130 + 16.25 × chain level additional damage each. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Earthbreaker
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 195% health. Every third valid direct hit shakes an 8-cell area around the target, dealing 65 + 39 × the wearer's health multiplier additional damage to up to 16 enemies. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Apex inventor
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants 195 item haste. Applicable item cooldowns are divided by 1 + haste/100. Ascension rerolls per day are unchanged. Draft limit: 6 stacks; older excess stacks are preserved.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bloodthirster
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 9.1% direct-damage lifesteal against enemies per stack, healing ordinary injuries only. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mighty
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 40% direct damage against enemies per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Courage of the colossus
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Successfully stunning an enemy grants a shield of 26 × stacks × (1 + RimHex health bonus), lasting 5 seconds. Control benefits trigger at most once per second. Everfrost can trigger this effect. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Critical Healing
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack adds 18.2% critical value. Healing and shields can critically strike using the holder's critical value. The bonus critical healing multiplier is 65% at one stack, capped at 100% with multiple stacks; excess critical value also benefits from this factor.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Deft
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 0.5 to melee and ranged attack cooldown divisors per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Tailwind
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 12% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Fan the flames
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Valid hits add 2.6 × stacks damage per second to the target's burn and refresh it to six pulses. Accumulates in the same attacker's burn as Infernal conduit. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Glass cannon
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 91% direct damage against enemies per stack. Damage taken multiplier increases by 25% per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Golden spatula
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 45.5% construction speed, 45.5% plant work speed and 11.375% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Goliath
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 100% health, 30% damage against enemies and 0.25 to the damage-taken divisor per stack. Does not change body size. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Cruel amusement
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Successfully stunning an enemy heals the wearer for 16.25 × stacks ordinary injury points. Shares the once-per-second trigger interval with other control benefits. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Crash course
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each day grants all free colonists 1,000 × stacks base experience in both Shooting and Melee. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Heavy hitter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each valid direct attack deals an additional 3.25 × stacks × the wearer's total health scale damage. The scale includes racial health and augment bonuses. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Homeguard
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After 5 seconds without being attacked, gains 68.25% × stacks movement speed. Being attacked removes the bonus until another five seconds pass. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Infernal Conduit
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct hits apply stacking burn. Burning refunds item and ability cooldowns at most once per second: 0.325 seconds per card stack, up to 10 seconds per trigger. Ethereal Weapon also lets abilities apply this burn. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Infernal soul
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Valid hits create a blast within 3.5 cells of the target, dealing 11.7 × stacks armor-piercing damage to up to 12 standing enemies. At most once every 2 seconds. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Critical edge
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 40% critical rating per stack. Rating above 100% further increases critical damage. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Lightkeeper
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: While standing, about every 12.5 seconds grants a 22.75 × stacks shield to up to 12 friendly colonists within 10 cells, including the wearer. Lasts 12.5 seconds. Refreshes retain the stronger shield. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Magic Missile
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Every third direct hit fires three missiles. The first effective ability hit on each enemy per cast also fires three. Each missile deals (5.2 + 1.95 × target health scale) secondary damage per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Master of Duality
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Direct hits build spell power; ability and secondary damage build attack power. Each temporary stack adds 3.9% ability/secondary damage or direct damage per card stack respectively. Secondary growth is limited to once per 10 ticks; bonuses lapse after 10 seconds without a direct hit. Draft limit: 6 stacks. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mind over matter
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each day grants all free colonists 130 × stacks base experience in every enabled skill. The game then applies normal learning modifiers. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Mountain soul
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: After 5 seconds without being attacked, refreshes a 26 × stacks shield about every 4.2 seconds, lasting about 8.3 seconds. Keeps the stronger capacity. Being attacked stops refreshes until the waiting condition is met again. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Ocean soul
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each valid hit heals the wearer for 5.2 × stacks ordinary injury points. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Perseverance
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: About every 4.2 seconds, heals 9.6 ordinary injury points per card stack, increased to 40 below 50% overall health. Can heal living downed colonists. Draft limit: 6 stacks; older excess stacks are preserved.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Phenomenal Evil
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Effective ability or secondary damage grants 0.65 permanent evil growth per card stack, once per 10 ticks. Each point adds 3% ability and secondary damage. Fractional growth is retained. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Apprentice rations
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: All colonists gain 70% learning speed per stack. Draft limit: 8 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Recursion
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants 65% item haste and 65% ability haste. Existing item benefits are retained. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Restless recovery
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: While moving, heals 12 × stacks ordinary injury points about every 4.2 seconds. Stops when stationary. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: All-purpose scope
